title: Jammed Free Spanish Berries Paella
description: A unique twist on traditional Spanish paella, this herbal and cozy dish features frozen mixed berries and is dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika and garlic powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fregula pasta and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the pasta is cooked through.
Stir in the thawed mixed berries, dried thyme, and lemon juice.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the berries have started to break down and the mixture is heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of pine nut meal, if desired.
Garnish with edible flowers or herbs, if desired for a pop of color.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days and reheat as needed.
Freeze for up to 2 months and thaw as needed
